newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae has reverse mortgage software.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae has reverse mortgage software.

text.p: Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) said on Wednesday that it was introducing a reverse mortgage software product called MORNETPlus Reverse Mortgage Assistant.
It said in a press release that the new software product is designed to lower costs and improve efficiency in reverse mortgage origination.
The software calculates available funds, payments and cost information.

The Reverse Mortgage Assistant offers payment plans which pay out on a monthly basis until the borrower no longer occupies the home, pay out over a fixed time period of several months, or allow borrowers to draw up to a maximum amount of cash at any time and in amounts of their choice.

The product, according to Fannie Mae, enables lenders and housing counselors to enter and analyze a homeowner's property and financial information to determine their best reverse mortgage options. Fannie Mae is offering the software free of charge to lenders and housing counseling agencies.
Reverse mortgages allow older home owners in the U.S. to convert the equity in their homes so that they can address personal financial needs.
Currently, Fannie Mae purchases two types of reverse mortgage products: FHA-insured Home Equity Conversion Mortgages and Fannie Mae's Home Keeper Mortgages.
